rule: If complaint location is Zahle district or EDZ concession area do not route to EDL.
notes: EDZ is the concession utility for Zahle and surrounding regions.

rule: Private generator equipment and subscription disputes are not EDL grid faults.
notes: Ask whether public grid is also affected.

rule: Faults after the private meter or inside the building are not ordinary EDL dispatch.
notes: Escalate only if public danger or grid asset evidence exists.

rule: Local public lighting fixture complaints default to municipality unless supply/grid hazard is visible.
notes: BC-001 already encodes streetlight to municipality.

rule: Use EDZ only for confirmed Zahle concession area.
notes: All other national grid-side complaints default to EDL unless another concession is verified.

rule: MEW is policy and escalation not ordinary field repair.
notes: Do not send routine outage to MEW first.

rule: Civil Defense handles emergency safety not utility restoration.
notes: CD may be first call for danger then utility handles repair.
